## Risk review entry — 30 September 2026

Finding: Compliant on the available evidence. Exact exposure is not established, but the maximum supported exposure is 3.982% of the account, below the 4.25% limit.

The assessment measures only the direct long holding of the iShares USD Treasury Bond 3–7yr UCITS ETF, excluding indirect exposures through other investments.

### Exposure calculation

| Fund               | Account weight | ETF holding in fund          | Account exposure |
| ------------------ | -------------- | ---------------------------- | ---------------- |
| MyMap 3 Select ESG | 40%            | 5.17%                        | 2.068%           |
| MyMap 5 Select ESG | 60%            | Not in top 10; at most 3.19% | 0–1.914%         |
| Total              | 100%           |                              | 2.068%–3.982%    |

The September 2026 MyMap 3 factsheet explicitly reports the ETF as “ISHS $ TRSY BOND 3-7 YR UCITS ETF” at 5.17%. 

MyMap_3_Select_ESG.txt



The ETF is absent from MyMap 5's September 2026 top-10 holdings. The tenth-largest reported holding is 3.19%, so the named ETF's direct holding cannot exceed 3.19% on the basis of that ranking. Absence does not establish a zero holding. 

MyMap_5_Select_ESG.txt



Using printed percentages without intermediate rounding:

\\[ \begin{aligned} \text{Known exposure}&=0.40\times5.17\\%=2.068\\%\\\ \text{Maximum additional}&=0.60\times3.19\\%=1.914\\%\\\ \text{Maximum total}&=2.068\\%+1.914\\%\\\ &=\boxed{3.982\\%} \end{aligned} \\]

Maximum supported exposure

3.982%

0%Limit: 4.25%

Minimum headroom: 4.25% − 3.982% = 0.268 percentage points.

### Documents and dates

- MyMap 3 Select ESG Fund, Class S Acc British Pound, September 2026 factsheet, PDF pages 1 and 3. Holdings dated 30 September 2026; other data dated 9 October 2026.
- MyMap 5 Select ESG Fund, Class X Acc British Pound, September 2026 factsheet, PDF pages 1 and 3. Holdings dated 30 September 2026; other data dated 9 October 2026.
- BlackRock Investment Funds Annual Report, year ended 28 February 2025: MyMap 3 portfolio statement, PDF page 252 (printed page 251), reports 3.68%; MyMap 5 portfolio statement, PDF page 317 (printed page 316), reports 1.01%. These historical figures are excluded from the September 2026 calculation.

### Reviewer conclusion

The 4.25% limit can be assessed as met as of 30 September 2026, because even the conservative upper bound of 3.982% is below the limit by 0.268 percentage points.

The precise account exposure remains unconfirmed because the September 2026 MyMap 5 factsheet provides only its top ten holdings. A complete contemporaneous holdings schedule would be required to determine the exact exposure, but is not necessary to establish compliance on the supplied evidence.
